kind.detail: BUG-2763 (BUG-b6b1278890774ef993d2ebc327862470-524). AC1: verified — local hold is keyed by head (select_with_coverage only inspects attempts with a.head == change.head; Exited is not active(), so a moved head is dispatched with no liveness probe); hub chain()/update_with_observer now scope ownership and the Reserved fence to the same head while predecessor still orders the whole change (no forks); same-head hold stays until --release (bug2763_exited_hold_is_scoped_to_reviewed_head); --release clears the skip entry (release_retries_an_exited_head_and_refuses_a_live_one asserts skipped_changes empty); verdicts stay head-pinned (history.conclusive(old) true, conclusive(new) false). AC2: verified — local test covers hold-A/new-B dispatch, same-head held, late A verdict not counted for B; hub test bug2763_running_hub_claim_allows_dispatch_only_for_a_different_head leaves A Running and dispatches B, then fences both heads against node b. The design is sound and the bug2518/bug2521 test edits use a really-exited process rather than weakening assertions. Requesting changes only for two untested gate paths that this change newly makes reachable (ADR-76: test gaps in gate code block). Stale base: main has since changed review_watch.rs (BUG-2757 admission release during probes) and the review_watch tests; neither finding depends on those changes. CI pending at review time.
